new_contribution: N0062 is the FIRST exposure of the frozen backbone's native-1/4 h1 (index 1, 96ch), injected as extra input channels into the DensityDecoder -- a decoder-RECEIVER-resolution widening. It is structurally distinct from: N0056 (XFine added fine-scale entropy to the EXEMPLAR AGGREGATION, producer side), N0053 (RGA was a spatial OUTPUT BIAS on density, output side), N0059/N0060 (ROI summaries over the exemplar ROI), and N0061/N0037 (count/readout multiplier). None touched the DECODER INPUT at native 1/4. The new axis = receiver-resolution enrichment (native-1/4 per-cell fidelity placed directly into the decoder), grounded by N0026's tail-error-falls-with-resolution finding; the change is decoder-input-wide (in_ch 192->200, +20k params) with exemplar/condenser/GCA/count/attention and the fused prototype fully untouched.
